instruction: A dainty mermaid figurine in glazed porcelain, her flowing hair and curling scaled tail hand-painted in soft aqua and gold luster. The glossy ceramic glaze catches highlights along her graceful pose, and tiny gilded shell accents trim the wave-shaped base.
